verdict.rationale: Gusto's own Business Compliance service files state annual and initial reports in all 50 states and sends deadline alerts, so the filing itself can be handed off with little owner effort. Gusto also offers an MCP server and CLI for AI agents, but the documented agent scope covers payroll Q&A, payroll prep, and reports, with no evidence it reaches compliance filings. Missing for 10: evidence that an AI agent (via MCP/CLI) can prepare or trigger annual reports and compliance filings, documentation of agent-accessible compliance endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven filing.
